title: HolyHUD
description: Displays a beautiful Bible verse on your screen every 2 minutes with a smooth white fade in and fade out effect. A simple reminder of God's Word while you play.
body:
HolyHUD displays a rotating Bible verse on your screen every 2 minutes while you play Minecraft. Each verse fades in and out smoothly in white text on the bottom left of your screen — a quiet reminder of God's Word no matter what you're building.

Features:
- 25 hand picked Bible verses
- Smooth white fade in and fade out effect
- Displays every 2 minutes automatically
- Lightweight and simple — no configuration needed
- Works with Fabric 1.20.1

Made with faith by NaroFaith. John 3:16
